title: 别烧店，用AI翻身
summary: 绝望的火锅店老板想烧店了断，朋友用AI帮他算账、引流，三个月后店里翻台排到门口。

shots.dialogue: 老板（独白）：房租、人工、欠的债……这店，我烧了算了。

Subject razor sharp in foreground, dim tables and chairs plus a cold blue neon sign outside the window fall into soft bokeh. Low-key lighting, warm yellow hanging lamp against cool teal shadows, rim light on his shoulders. Slow dolly-in with subtle handheld drift, mood of despair, no on-screen text.
